Welcome to the return area. Please stop your car in any open lane. An agent is coming to check your car. Please take all your bags, your phone and your sunglasses, and give the key to the agent. The agent is checking the gas and the car, and you receive your receipt by email. Our shuttle is leaving every ten minutes to all the airport terminals. Thank you for choosing us.

Hi, honey, it's me. I am in the shuttle now. We are going to the terminal. The traffic is terrible, but we are moving. The kids are sleeping, finally! Are you waiting at Terminal D? Okay, good. The flight is leaving on time, so please check the bags with the airline. I am arriving in about ten minutes. See you soon!

Carlos is driving to the airport. He is returning the car at the return lane. The agent is checking the gas and the car. She says: There is a scratch on the door. Carlos explains: It was there on the first day. He is running to the shuttle with his receipt.
